usedFor: Commerce Layer reports store events like “When a new customer is created”, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new customer is created” in Commerce Layer, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new customer in your store starts a command on your own machine.

watchOut: “When a new price is created” is polling, so “Trigger Command” runs a little after the price is added.
